name: Prepositions in Pictures
prompt:
Create a landscape 3-by-2 educational card sheet to show English prepositions. Use {{object}} and {{reference}} consistently in every panel. The six panels, in reading order, illustrate exactly: in, on, under, next to, behind, in front of.
Make the spatial relation physically clear and distinct. For "in", open the lid or use a cutaway so the object is visibly inside; for "on", close the lid and show contact with its top surface. For "under", use a simple raised support so the object can clearly sit below the box. For "behind", retain enough of the object to make its position clear. Use a simple shared viewpoint, soft grounding shadows, and no distracting props.
Below each panel, render only the corresponding preposition or phrase exactly as listed. Use large legible lettering, generous spacing, equal panel sizes, and a neutral background. Do not include a title, translation, arrows that obscure the scene, or extra labels.

Use original, generic subjects, with no logos, branded characters, or imitation of a named artist. Do not add a watermark, decorative writing, or extra labels. Render only the specified text, with clear spacing and high contrast; if it cannot be rendered reliably, leave that text area blank rather than inventing letters. Any generated lettering must be checked before learning or printing.

title_i18n.ja: 絵で学ぶ位置の前置詞

description: Contrast spatial relationships using the same two objects across six panels.

variables.name: object
variables.description: One small concrete object used in every panel.

variables.name: reference
variables.default: a blue box with a flat lid
variables.description: A box-like container with a lid, suitable for all six spatial relationships.
